# Recipes deliberately excluded from the build.
#
# Every name here must be either an existing bins/<name>.sh or a tool the
# installers request that no recipe produces. gen_recipes.sh enforces that,
# so a typo cannot silently fail to drop anything.
#
# The matching lines must also be removed from the installers in the Arsenal
# fork, or users will curl a 404.

# Builds nothing. Re-downloads prebuilt AppImages from a third-party CDN
# (pkg.ajam.dev), which this project no longer depends on. It was the only
# genuine third-party-host dependency among the in-scope recipes.
# Removing it also drops: magick.no_strip, imagemagick.no_strip,
# magick_appbundle.no_strip
magick

# Not needed. Was the sole user of the azathothas/debian-builder-unstable
# Docker image; dropping it leaves exactly one external builder image.
# Removing it also drops: hf-cli
huggingface-cli

# Not needed. Was the sole host-side user of PyInstaller; dropping it removes
# PyInstaller, Nuitka and Pex from the toolchain entirely.
archey

# Broken upstream drift. The recipe builds ZeroTierOne from source but the
# expected binaries (zerotier-one, zerotier-cli, zerotier-idtool) never
# materialize at the paths the recipe copies from (`cp: cannot stat
# './zerotier-one'`), so the published package held only a systemd service
# file. Nobody needs it; drop until someone ports a working build.
# Removing it also drops: zerotier-cli, zerotier-idtool, zerotier-one
zerotier
